blocks.text: English mahir-e-hayatiyat Francis Crick ne gene expression ke tareeqe ke liye 'central dogma' ki istilah use ki. Is ke mutabiq maloomat genes (DNA) se gene ki RNA copy tak jati hai, aur RNA copy amino acids ki zanjeer ko tarteeb se jorne ki hidayat deti hai. Mukhtasar: DNA se RNA se protein.

blocks.alt: Oopar se neeche bahao: oopar DNA double helix; hara teer 'Transcription (DNA -> RNA)' neeche aik strand wale RNA tak; hara teer 'Translation (RNA -> Protein)' neeche motiyon ki zanjeer jaisi protein tak.
blocks.caption: Figure 19.12: Central dogma (kitab ki Figure 19.12 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

items: Translation: RNA ki maloomat se protein banana.

blocks.text: Genetic maloomat ka bahao aik taraf hai: jab maloomat protein mein chali jaye to wapas nahi aati.

blocks.title: Khane ki tarakeeb ki kitab
blocks.text: DNA ko library (nucleus) mein mehfooz tarakeeb ki kitab samjhiye. Aap aik tarkeeb ki photocopy (mRNA) le kar kitchen (ribosome) jate hain jahan khana (protein) pakta hai. Kitab khud kabhi library se bahar nahi jati.

blocks.explanation: Transcription (DNA se RNA) aur translation (RNA se protein).

items: Crick (1957): DNA se RNA se protein; maloomat aik taraf.
